description: Enphase persona-specific Figma email prompt rules (SFMC).
rules: Enphase persona requirement: build the email starting from the exact boilerplate of the approved Enphase main reference (references/Enphase_Main_Reference.html): its doctype, html namespaces, MSO conditional blocks, meta tags, complete CSS reset and email-client fixes, responsive utility class library, breakpoints, and outer wrapper/main-table structure. Set the document title and main-table width from the Figma metadata. The sample content blocks inside the reference remain forbidden as content sources.
Enphase persona requirement: every anchor must include conversion, data-linkto, href, title, and alias; web links also require target="_blank".
Enphase static web URLs must append utm_campaign=%%=v(@utm_campaign)=%% using ? when no query exists and & when a query already exists; never duplicate utm_campaign.
Enphase mailto and sms links use conversion="false" and data-linkto="other" and must not receive campaign UTM parameters.

If any phone number appears in an Enphase email, declare @CallCTA with CloudPagesURL before HTML and use href="%%=RedirectTo(@CallCTA)=%%" on phone-number anchors with conversion="true" and data-linkto="https://".
